parsed.notes:
Dein Profil supplies the candidate requirements; technologies appearing only under Deine Aufgaben are excluded.
The inline wording 'sind willkommen' is interpreted as an optional marker for CI/CD, Container-Orchestrierung and Infrastructure as Code. CI/CD in responsibilities does not create a required criterion.
Container orchestration and modern development processes have no matching taxonomy entries; neither Kubernetes nor DevOps is inferred.
Selecting and assessing suitable ML methods is read literally, without adding separate model-selection or evaluation skills.
The unspecified completed degree maps to bachelor; alternative quantitative subjects widen the field rather than permit equivalent experience.
